messages.subject: Looking for a short/mid-term R/Shiny developer (we are based in DC, authorized to work in the US)
parts:
My team is looking to hire a R/Shiny developer (consultant basis, 2-to-3 months, else a young scientist, authorized to work in the U.S.) to create web front-ends for some of our economic and geo-spatial models, see http://harvestchoice.org/. Some GIS knowledge preferred. Need a good grasp of the following packages: data.table,sp, rgdal, rgeos, raster, shiny, leaflet, tmap, htmlwidgets.
We are based in DC. Please respond to this thread.﻿
Thanks, --Mel.

-- 
Melanie BACOU
International Food Policy Research Institute
Snr. Program Manager, Spatial Data and Analytics
Visit www.harvestchoice.org
